paper_title: Evidence for light-by-light scattering and searches for axion-like particles in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions at $\sqrt{s_\mathrm{NN}} =$ 5.02 TeV
coupling_convention: 1/Lambda (GeV^-1) = g_agamma, plotted directly as on y-axis
notes: CMS light-by-light scattering in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions sets 95% CL exclusion limits on pseudoscalar ALP production via gamma gamma -> a -> gamma gamma over m_a = 5-90 GeV. Limits are presented in the g_agamma (=1/Lambda) vs m_a plane in Fig. 7, and cross-section limits (1500-20 nb) in Fig. 6. This is a collider bound (not a DM haloscope), so no local DM density applies. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton, but no numerical (mass, coupling) pairs are given in the text/tables; the g_agamma limits exist only in figures and cannot be reliably extracted, hence empty data_points and low extraction confidence. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Figure 7 left panel (operator aFF~/4Lambda, ALP-photon coupling only). Traced green solid 'PbPb 5.02 TeV observed' curve, the lower boundary of the excluded region (excluded above).
